data_fields.name: entry_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: default 1; a chance of 1 skips the random draw

data_fields.name: entry_amount
data_fields.donor_constant: default 1; written as 'N item' in zon

data_fields.name: tool_tag_filter
data_fields.donor_constant: allowedToolTags list (tool must carry one); forbiddenToolTags list (any match blocks); no tool = only entries without allowed list

data_fields.name: rolls_per_event
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (itemDropsOnChange returns 1 when the block type changes, else 0)

data_fields.name: drop_launch_speed
data_fields.donor_constant: 3.5 + signed random * 0.5; x0.333 for downward faces

best_idea: Roll each loot-table entry on its own chance, filter entries by the killing tool's tags, and let only the server roll once per confirmed kill.
decision_why: Frankendom needs one server-rolled loot table per creature; take the entry shape (independent chance, all-or-nothing stack bundles, tool-tag filter) as creature data, but reject the block-change trigger, the vector launch and the first-come pickup, which fit neither server-verified kills nor an owner-based ledger.
acceptance: A server test runs 10,000 confirmed kills of a creature whose entry has chance 0.25 and gets 0.25 +/- 0.02 drops; a tool-tag-gated entry never drops for a hit with no matching tag; only the server writes the ledger row. A player sees a loot pile at the kill spot that they can take within 1.0 unit of their box and that disappears after 900 s.
